command:
git fetch --no-tags https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5.git main:refs/remotes/origin/main || true
git fetch --unshallow > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "=== conventions"
python3 tools/check_conventions.py --base origin/main
echo "=== overlap"
python3 tools/pr_overlap.py --branch HEAD 2>&1 | tail -25 || echo "OVERLAP_TOOL_FAILED"
echo "=== configure"
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++ -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 configure.log; exit 1; }
echo "=== build"
cmake --build build --target libSceLibcInternal guest_libc_internal_aligned_new_tests guest_libc_internal_mtx_tests guest_init_once_tests guest_new_handler_tests --parallel 4 2>&1 | tail -8
echo "=== exports"
nm -D --defined-only build/core/libs/libs/unpatched/libSceLibcInternal.prx | grep -E "s2eGsgUF9vk|v09ZcAhZzSc"
echo "=== test"
ctest --test-dir build -R "guest_libc_internal|guest_new_handler|guest_init_once" --output-on-failure
